input: Draft an author bio for my upcoming short story collection

gold.taskTitle: Draft Author Bio for Short Story Collection
gold.taskDescription: Write a professional author biography to accompany the user's upcoming short story collection.

questions.title: What is your full name or pen name to use?
questions.description: Identify the exact name that should appear in the bio.

questions.title: What is the title or theme of the collection?
questions.description: Understand the collection's subject matter to make the bio contextually relevant.

questions.title: Where will this bio appear — book jacket, website, press kit?
questions.description: Determine the placement so tone and length can be calibrated appropriately.

questions.title: What writing credits or publications should be highlighted?
questions.description: Gather previous works, journals, anthologies, or awards to feature in the bio.

questions.title: What tone do you want — formal, warm, witty, literary?
questions.description: Establish the voice and personality the bio should convey to readers.

questions.title: What is the target word count or length for the bio?
questions.description: Set a clear length constraint, such as 50 words, 100 words, or a short paragraph.

questions.title: What personal details, if any, should be included?
questions.description: Clarify whether to mention location, background, education, day job, or personal interests.
